blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The implementation of the expanded number coding scheme will be suspended on Monday, November 2, according to the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA). The MMDA noted that it automatically suspends its number coding scheme during regular and special non-working holidays.
